items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I made several records with Louis and Joe under my baby sister's name

ctx.x: Oh, I think Mr. Bottoms was the one, but I won't be too positive about that. But I think it was Bottoms that sent for Louis, and not Joe, although it might have been Joe. But I think Mr. Bottoms was the one, because people had talked to him about Louis so much. Well, I might be wrong, I can't say for sure.

But anyway, they brought Louis up. And that's when I started working with Louis. And I made several records with Louis and Joe under my baby sister's name, Josephine, Josephine Beatty, B-e-a-t-t-y. I made records under her name, because I was -- in the meantime, they sent for me to record for
Paramount. Now, wait a minute, I'm ahead of my story, because I had done notes on some recording already for the Black Swan record. That was Pace and Handy.
